turns.user: I purchased a mobile single ticket in BudapestGO yesterday. Can I replace it with another ticket?
turns.agent:
No—BKK’s policy says mobile-app tickets cannot be exchanged or replaced. If yours is an unused mobile single ticket, though, it may be eligible for a refund through the app within one year of purchase, subject to the product’s conditions. Since you bought it yesterday, that timing appears to fit, but I can’t process or confirm a refund for you.

This is based on the limited BKK policy cross-check dated 6 November 2026. See BKK’s product replacement and refund policy.
